J10 visible in assembly drawings and Gerber output; existing J8/J9 factory socket aliases retained.
Six printed parts and107 STEP reference solids; all20 modeled assembly/service stages pass. B extraction and connector corridor include J10.

limits: Engineering visual review; not factory sourcing/orientation/process approval, physical fit, electrical or thermal qualification.
